historical_commentary.text: Inherited forms remain a supported concept in current 4D, so the core technique documented here is still broadly relevant, even though modern 4D development (especially in Project Mode) offers additional form-reuse and componentization options beyond what was available in 4D 6.8.
related_updates: Inherited forms remain a supported 4D feature today, though modern 4D projects have additional componentization options (e.g., form/page components) not available in 2003
